verdict.rationale: Synctera documents watchlist checks within its KYC/KYB verification, which covers sanctions screening. A learning-center FAQ on case notifications implies some case management. Its EDD feature supports AML review of high-risk customers and transactions, and the platform is pitched as shared operational tooling with the bank partner. Missing for 10: explicit transaction monitoring, alert-case workflow documentation, SAR-filing support, a documented split of compliance duties between fintech, platform and bank, and independent corroboration.
